chunks: So, go to your father and tell him: 'O father, your son has committed a theft. We bear witness to only what we know; we could not prevent the unknown.'

key_terms.سَرَقَ: he was stolen / he committed theft

ai.seo_question: What did Joseph's brothers say to their father Jacob about his disappearance?
ai.summary: In this verse, Joseph's brothers return to Jacob to report his disappearance, claiming he was stolen and asserting, 'We bear witness only to what we know,' which Shia scholars interpret as a rhetorical device to mask their guilt by limiting their testimony to visible facts while implying they were not keeping guard over the unseen. This phrase highlights their partial truthfulness, as they knew the truth but chose to present a plausible yet incomplete account, a nuance emphasized in Tafsir al-Ayyashi and al-Majlisi. The incident underscores the theme of divine wisdom in using human deception to fulfill prophetic destiny, a key concept in Shia exegesis of the Story of the Prophets.
